recent_posts.title: How contextual intelligence transforms AI assisted coding from chaos to systematic development
recent_posts.summary: Contextual Intelligence transforms chaotic AI-assisted coding into systematic development by using specialized AI personas that capture, process, and transfer context between development phases. The approach introduces six personas (Farseer, Spiritwalker, Kodo, Chieftain, Grunt, Witchdoctor) that handle strategic analysis, legacy system understanding, architectural planning, work breakdown, implementation, and project monitoring. Instead of losing context between phases, each persona enriches understanding for the next, preventing technical debt accumulation and enabling AI to amplify good practices rather than accelerate bad ones.

recent_posts.title: Fastify HTTP Timeout Handling Guide
recent_posts.summary: Fastify provides multiple timeout configurations to protect servers from malicious clients and resource exhaustion. Key timeout settings include headersTimeout, requestTimeout, connectionTimeout, and keepAliveTimeout, each serving different purposes in the HTTP request lifecycle. The article demonstrates how to configure these timeouts with practical examples and testing scripts, emphasizing the importance of balancing security, performance, and user experience when setting timeout values.

recent_posts.title: Fastify Request-Scoped Data Management
recent_posts.summary: Managing request-scoped data in Fastify can be efficiently handled using the @fastify/request-context plugin, which leverages AsyncLocalStorage introduced in Node.js 13. This plugin simplifies state management, improves code maintainability, and ensures that request-specific data is consistently and safely accessible throughout the request lifecycle without the hassle of manual context management or data leakage across requests.

recent_posts.title: Official Release Date of 'Accelerating Server-Side Development with Fastify' Book
recent_posts.summary: Authors Manuel Spigolon, Maksim Sinik, and Matteo Collina announce the release of their book 'Accelerating Server-Side Development with Fastify' on June 9, 2023. This comprehensive guide covers Fastify's core concepts, routing, plugins, testing, and deployment strategies, offering valuable insights for both beginners and advanced developers looking to build high-performance web applications with the Fastify framework.

recent_posts.title: How to build a Pokedex with Platformatic
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to build a Pokedex application using Platformatic, a fast backend development platform built on Fastify. The guide includes setting up a Platformatic project, preparing the database, adding a user interface with React, serving static files, implementing pagination, search, custom queries, and deploying the application to Platformatic Cloud.

recent_posts.title: Streaming PostgreSQL data with Fastify
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to efficiently stream large datasets from a PostgreSQL database to a React client using Fastify. The guide explores both batch processing and streaming approaches, demonstrates how to set up a Fastify server, and provides practical implementation with the pg-query-stream library. Performance comparisons between the two methods help in choosing the best approach for improved user experience and responsive UI.

recent_posts.title: how jest testing framework works and why instanceof is not working
recent_posts.summary: Jest, a popular testing framework by Facebook, is known for its isolation features that enhance performance but may cause issues with the instanceof operator in Node.js applications. This post examines why these problems occur and offers solutions, such as using jest-environment-node-single-context or jest-light-runner. It also suggests considering alternative frameworks like node-tap or requesting libraries to remove instanceof-based checks.

recent_posts.title: Build a Telegram Bot Using Fastify
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to create a Telegram bot from scratch using the Fastify framework and Platformatic tools. This guide covers setting up the project, implementing the bot using Fastify plugins, and integrating it with a database for user registration. By the end, you'll have a basic bot that can be further customized to suit your needs.

recent_posts.title: New Fastify Application Hook Released!
recent_posts.summary: Fastify has introduced a new onListen application hook with the release of version 4.23.0. This hook is called when the server is actively listening to incoming requests, allowing asynchronous tasks to be executed without delaying application startup. It complements existing hooks and is particularly useful for tasks like loading external data to populate the application cache. If the onListen hook throws an error, the application will still start, but caution should be exercised to avoid race conditions when loading necessary data.

recent_posts.title: Fastify Book Accelerating Server-Side Development with Fastify
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to build scalable and maintainable API servers with the book 'Accelerating Server-Side Development with Fastify.' Tailored for mid to expert back-end engineers familiar with Node.js, this comprehensive guide explores Fastify's core features, encapsulation techniques, project organization, and real-world application development. The book also covers advanced topics such as microservices, performance improvement, and developing GraphQL APIs.
